catalogue_recurrence_use.non_strict_or_no_catalogue_source: candidate short-lag comparison only; requires native-pixel sensitivity/recurrence validation
catalogue_recurrence_use.strict_recurrence: not a short-lag negative; exclude from pixel-negative queue

comparison_plate_rule: Use only v077a rows already marked eligible_independent_comparison=True and independent_physical_plate=True. For physical plates with multiple exposure rows, retain every resolved exposure interval and use the minimum actual gap only for tier assignment; record all intervals and flag multi-exposure plates.
gap_definition: Actual interval-to-interval gap. If comparison exposure overlaps the science-overlap interval, gap=0. If it ends before the science overlap, gap=science_start-comparison_end. If it starts after the science overlap, gap=comparison_start-science_end. No midpoint substitution.
purpose: Return to the frozen whole Pair-17 opportunity population (v077a/v078a) and identify independent physical comparison plates whose actual exposure intervals fall within prospectively frozen short-lag tiers around the authoritative 299 s Pair-17 science overlap. Catalogue recurrence is used only to triage which short-lag plates require native-pixel validation; catalogue absence is not promoted to a qualified negative.

timing_recovery.source_policy: Recover exact exposure rows from already-local/banked APPLAUSE/TAP products referenced by v077a query manifests or nearby cache files. Require an exposure id plus exact start and exact end, or a duration with explicit/declared seconds. If an exposure interval cannot be resolved unambiguously, preserve it as TIMING_UNRESOLVED and do not tier it.
